## Answer

The New York City Department of Parks and Recreation announced the renaming of Railroad Park in Queens to **Gwen Ifill Park** on **Wednesday, June 16, 2021**. The renaming was part of a broader initiative to rename 16 park spaces across the city in honor of the Black experience, announced by NYC Parks Commissioner Mitchell J. tool.text:
**Short answer:** There is no record of Gustav Mahler being inducted into a "Classical Music Hall of Fame." The main such institution, the **American Classical Music Hall of Fame and Museum** (Cincinnati, founded 1996, first inductees 1998), has never inducted Mahler — its full inductee lists from 1998 through 2020 contain no Mahler. The only "Hall of Fame" tied to Mahler is the **Classic FM Hall of Fame**, a UK radio listener poll of favorite classical works, where his symphonies appear as ranked entries (e.g., Symphony No. 5), not as a personal induction.

So the premise of the question appears to be false — Mahler was not inducted into a Classical Music Hall of Fame in any year.

ANSWER: No such induction occurred — Gustav Mahler was never inducted into a Classical Music Hall of Fame (the American Classical Music Hall of Fame has no Mahler in its inductee lists, 1998–2020).
